8 Apr 2023
The insured reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection and the claimant's vehicle was struck from
behind while stopped. The claimant reports neck pain and was not represented by an attorney at first contact.
12 Apr 2023
Photos taken at the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk area of the claimant's vehicle, which lines up
with the impact described. The driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of loss.
3 Jun 2023
Our contact with the claimant covered the same account of events as the first call, with no changes to the sequence
or the location. There are no independent witnesses, so the photos and the statements are the main sources we
have.
14 Jun 2023
The reported neck injury fits the kind and force of a rear impact of this type. No earlier injury to the same body area is
known, and nothing in the file suggests prior damage to the vehicle or damage that predates the policy start.
29 Oct 2023
The claimant's treatment followed a usual course and eased off as recovery progressed. Reocrds are still being
gathered, and it is not fully clear from the file where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting at impact.
7 Nov 2023
Vehicle damage was reviewed against the reported impact and matches the described collision. Based on what is in
the file, the calim is moving forward for further evaluation of the injury portion.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
